about: Per territory and era: [main faith, main culture (1-based indexes into religions.json / cultures.json items), development score 0-100 relative to its era, GDP per person in 2011 dollars (0 before 1815), second faith, second culture (indexes as before, 0 when no other group holds 10% of the people), estimated % of the people in the main faith, main culture, second faith and second culture (0 when not known: an unknown main group, or a hand-corrected main group the estimate puts second)]. Population-weighted estimates plus hand corrections.
